assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one production sprite atlas for a seated VR illustrated theatre, Sankofa.
Create a SINGLE transparent PNG sprite sheet, portrait 2:3 canvas, arranged as EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of equal cells. SIX full-body cut-out illustrations, one per cell. No captions, numbers, borders, background, shadows on a floor, props, lettering, or watermark. Leave generous transparent padding between every cell. All figures fit entirely inside their own cell; no overlap. Their feet share the same baseline within each cell and heads share the same scale. Draw the same two fictional women consistently across all three rows.
LEFT COLUMN: Wambui, a fictional adult East African woman with deep brown skin, a warm ochre modest wrapped garment and ivory shoulder cloth, short natural hair.
RIGHT COLUMN: Naserian, another fictional adult East African woman with deep brown skin, a muted brick-red modest wrapped garment and indigo shoulder cloth, short natural hair.
These are theatrical reconstructions, NOT portraits of real people, and NOT a claim to authentic ethnic costume. Avoid generic tribal ornaments, headdresses, fantasy, exaggerated anatomy, jewelry and stereotypes. Both have dignified, warm, expressive illustrated faces and believable anatomy.
ROW 1: both standing quietly in a three-quarter view toward each other, arms relaxed.
ROW 2: left woman offers something with an OPEN EMPTY right palm extended gently toward the viewer at waist height, supporting left hand nearby; right woman opens both EMPTY hands at waist height to receive something toward the center. Absolutely no vessel or object drawn in either hand: a separate real 3D gourd will occupy that space in Unity.
ROW 3: left woman has given the object away, open relaxed palms and a small warm smile; right woman acknowledges the exchange with one open palm toward the other woman and the other at her chest.
Style: beautiful editorial gouache and ink cut-paper illustration, tactile pigment, confident dark ink contours, expressive warm faces, clean readable silhouettes and richly shaded fabric folds. Mature cinematic illustrated folktale, subtle amber fire illumination and cool blue edge shading. Each illustration should feel like hand-painted book art brought to human scale. Preserve real alpha transparency outside the silhouettes. No rectangular paper backdrop, no photorealism, no 3D rendering.
